text:
maria: kicking off account/project + VNet scaffold for eu-west-3 (new GPU region). high level checklist below, please chime in.

sam: thanks — adding a couple constraints we observed last time: no overlapping CIDRs with corp peering, and GCP quota for A2/A100 needs 72h lead time if we exceed defaults.

oliver: for clarity, is this going into the existing `redwood-prod` org or is it a new org-level project?

maria: new project under `redwood-eu3` org folder. staging and prod projects separate: `eu3-staging-ops` and `eu3-prod-ops`.

kai: i'll own the infra terraform handoff. quick notes: use `10.40.0.0/16` for the VNet, split into `/20` subnets per AZ (10.40.0.0/20, 10.40.16.0/20, 10.40.32.0/20). keep a /24 reserved for infra mgmt.

sam: can we avoid 10.0.0.0/8 space to reduce corporate overlap risk? prefer 10.40/16 as suggested. also add explicit tag policy: `team:infra`, `env:prod|staging`, `cost-center:inference`.

maria: agreed. high-level runbook (short):
1) Create GCP project + billing linkage (`eu3-prod-ops`).
2) Enable APIs: compute.googleapis.com, servicenetworking.googleapis.com, cloudresourcemanager.googleapis.com.
3) Create VPC `vpc-eu3-prod` with CIDR `10.40.0.0/16`.
4) Create subnets per AZ (as kai suggested).
5) Private Google access and DNS peering with corp VPC.
6) Configure firewall rules: allow internal (10.40/16) and restricted SSH from jump hosts.
7) Create shared services subnet for nat/gke control-plane.
8) Request GPU quota increases + reserved IPs.
9) Run validation (see tests below).
10) Handoff to platform oncall + tag owners.

oliver: for step 5 — service networking peering needs a specific CIDR for private services. use `172.16.100.0/24` (reserved).

maria: noted. GPU quota request details:
- Region: eu-west-3
- Machine types: a2-highgpu-1g, a2-megagpu-4g (we'll request 16 A100 initially)
- Project: eu3-prod-ops
- Justification: production LLM inference capacity for early customers + canary testing

sam: add fallback plan: if A100 quota delayed, allow scheduling to eu-west-1 or use T4s with lower perf for non-latency-critical workloads. include routing policy in runtime.

kai: terraform modules I'm going to use: `redwood-org/project`, `redwood-network/vpc`, `redwood-network/subnet`, `redwood-iam/service-account`. I'll open a PR with variableized CIDR and tags.

maria: validation checklist (run after terraform apply):
- VPC exists + subnets present (az mapping correct)
- Firewall rules: internal allowed, ssh locked to `jump-hosts` tag
- Private GCP access and DNS peering operational (resolve internal service names)
- NAT gateway + default route tested via ephemeral VM
- GPU quota shows as requested & reserved in cloud console
- Service account permissions: `compute.admin` restricted to infra team; `service-usage.quota` for quota management delegated to platform-admins
- Cost export: billing account linked + dataset + daily export configured

oliver: testing commands i'll run:
```
# from bastion
gcloud compute instances create test-vm --zone=eu-west-3-a --machine-type=e2-medium --subnet=eu3-a-subnet --no-address
gcloud compute ssh test-vm --internal-ip --zone=eu-west-3-a --command='curl http://metadata.google.internal/computeMetadata/v1/instance/id' -H 'Metadata-Flavor: Google'
```

sam: add a smoke GPU allocation test once quota is granted:
```
gcloud compute instances create gpu-test --zone=eu-west-3-b --accelerator="type=nvidia-tesla-a100,count=1" --maintenance-policy=TERMINATE --image-family=common-cu118 --machine-type=a2-highgpu-1g
```

maria: handoff template for platform oncall (what to include in the ticket):
- Project & billing IDs
- VPC + subnet CIDRs and AZ mapping
- GPU quota request ref# and expected fulfillment date
- Access: service accounts + owners + escalation contacts
- Validation logs & smoke test link
- Cost projection (monthly estimate)

kai: cost projection rough: 16 A100s (on-demand) ~ $60k/mo; with sustained discounts / committed use could be ~ $36k/mo. include a note to evaluate dedicated reservations for predictable workloads.

maria: action items:
- kai: open terraform PR for project/vpc/subnets + add tags (ETA today)
- sam: submit GPU quota request + paste ref number here (ETA 24h)
- oliver: prepare peering & DNS notes, run validation commands after apply (ETA tomorrow)

infra-bot: created ticket INFRA-3289: "eu-west-3 project + vnet scaffold" assigned to @kai, due 2026-02-12 17:00 UTC

maria: thanks — once PR merged and quota in place i'll schedule a quick handoff session with platform oncall. :+1:

sam: ping me if quota support asks for additional justification.

oliver: once we have private-peering done, i'll verify cross-project access to the model registry and artifact storage.

maria: closing thread — will post PR link and quota ref here when available.
